name: The Red ladder (station 8; biomes/gills/PLAN.md section 11 item 2): up the Godthrone's south-east flank at 8.2-8.9 km, the Red Gills' cracks iced over, the out-breath frozen into fumarolic ice towers on their lips, frost jets on the bare ground over the dry-cold line with rime fans on their lee, palagonite ridges under the line; the breath still comes on the hour
